name: Labadie Creek-Missouri River
about: Labadie Creek-Missouri River drains about 60 square miles, 48% of it in St. Charles County. The land ranges from about 870 feet above sea level at its highest point to about 460 feet at its lowest. Its main streams are Bigelow Creek, Labadie Creek, Fisher Creek and Dunn Spring Creek. It includes part of Augusta. Downstream, its water passes through the Wildhorse Creek-Missouri River, Greens Chute-Missouri River and Duckett Creek-Missouri River watersheds on its way down the Missouri River, which joins the Mississippi River at the east end of St. Charles County.
